structured_output.title: ACME HTTP01 PathType change may affect Ingress challenges
structured_output.content: This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 with a value key `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` present, suggesting HTTP challenge capability is configured. The upgrade to v1.18.0 changes ACME HTTP01 Ingress challenge routes to use `PathType: Exact` instead of the previous behavior, which is a breaking change affecting standards-compliant Ingress controllers. Inspect your ClusterIssuers, Issuers, and Certificates to confirm whether any use ACME HTTP01 challenge types with Ingress routes; if they do, review whether your Ingress controller (and any path-matching logic) will correctly handle exact path matching semantics.
